response.quote_a: Those Teachers, other than Headmasters (Gr.II) who have completed eight (8) academic years of service in a particular school as on the date of closure of Academic Year i.e 31 st May of that Year shall be transferred compulsorily.
response.quote_b: Only teachers who have completed ten academic years in the school shall be included in the compulsory list.
response.explanation: Document A mandates compulsory transfer for teachers after eight academic years of service, whereas Document B states that only teachers who have completed ten academic years shall be included in the compulsory list.
